ball_radius.prov: user/HANDOFF: POLLEN 2.8 in dia (AndyMark am-5851); not re-measured here

pivot.prov: confirmed: CM 9.6.1 'Frame supports 2 pivots with their axis 43.95 in. (111.65 cm) above the TILES' (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm); CAD pivot bracket origin at 43.950 in. 43.95 in = 1.11633 m (manual's 111.65 cm is rounded).

tilt_deg.prov: confirmed value: CM Fig 9-10 '30 deg' (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm) and CAD (all HIVE parts at 30.000 deg). low/high derived from Field Acceptance Checklist 1.13 'bottom of each CELL opening is 53.5 +/- 0.50 in above the tiles' (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/field-check) solved for tilt with the CAD lip point (z'=-21.456, y'=-1.50 in) and pivot 43.95 in; checklist midpoint gives 30.36 deg.

mouth.prov: derived: mouth plane = outer face of the outer Goal Rib; p0 = lip top, p1 = inner roof apex (cell centre plane)

pose_neg.inside_prov: derived: cell interior at the centre plane deflated by ball_radius on floor, roof and Back Skin; mouth edge = mouth plane (ball centre past the mouth plane and in this box = retained). Off-centre planes have a lower roof (see cell_opening_profile).
pose_neg.reason: The upward CELL sits on the -x side and its mouth faces OUTWARD, away from the pivot: outward normal points -x and 30 deg above horizontal (mouth plane 60 deg from horizontal; floor slopes down toward the Back Skin so a ball that crosses the mouth rolls in). From the -x side a ball moving toward the pivot enters directly. From the other side the ball must clear the roof (outer apex ~1.69 m) and then cross the mouth plane inward, which needs a descent steeper than 60 deg below horizontal just beyond the roof front edge.

tilt_deg.prov: confirmed value: CM Fig 9-10 '30 deg' (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/game/cm-html/BIOBUZZ%20Competition%20Manual%20-%20TU07.htm) and CAD (all HIVE parts at 30.000 deg). low/high derived from Field Acceptance Checklist 1.13 'bottom of each CELL opening is 53.5 +/- 0.50 in above the tiles' (https://ftc-resources.firstinspires.org/ftc/archive/2027/field/field-check) solved for tilt with the CAD lip point (z'=-21.456, y'=-1.50 in) and pivot 43.95 in; checklist midpoint gives 30.36 deg.

mouth.prov: derived: mouth plane = outer face of the outer Goal Rib; p0 = lip top, p1 = inner roof apex (cell centre plane)

pose_pos.inside_prov: derived: cell interior at the centre plane deflated by ball_radius on floor, roof and Back Skin; mouth edge = mouth plane (ball centre past the mouth plane and in this box = retained). Off-centre planes have a lower roof (see cell_opening_profile).
pose_pos.reason: The upward CELL sits on the +x side and its mouth faces OUTWARD, away from the pivot: outward normal points +x and 30 deg above horizontal (mouth plane 60 deg from horizontal; floor slopes down toward the Back Skin so a ball that crosses the mouth rolls in). From the +x side a ball moving toward the pivot enters directly. From the other side the ball must clear the roof (outer apex ~1.69 m) and then cross the mouth plane inward, which needs a descent steeper than 60 deg below horizontal just beyond the roof front edge.

field.hive_location: HIVE Structure at the centre of the FIELD (CM 9.6); pivot axes run toward the two ALLIANCE walls; red HIVE on the red-alliance half (y<0 in CAD terms), blue on the blue half; CELLS tip toward the audience and far walls (x in this frame).

inner_wall_x.prov: derived: CAD perimeter glass inner face at +/-70.67 in from field centre; CM 9.2 'approximately 144 in. by 144 in.'

robot_height_limit.prov: confirmed: CM R105.A 18 x 24 x 29 in tall expansion volume after start; starting configuration 18 x 18 x 18 in

field.shooting_area: No LAUNCH zone restriction found in the TU07 manual: LAUNCHING into the upward-facing CELL is allowed from anywhere on the FIELD (G417 forbids other HIVE interaction; G409 no catching from a TIPPED HIVE).

open_questions: Damper state at rest: CAD shows both Blum 970A plungers fully extended (0.49 in exposed) with the contacting tip touching the A-Frame at 30.000 deg, i.e. first contact. Full plunger travel would add up to ~8 deg (lever 3.57 in), which the checklist (53.5 +/- 0.5 in when the damper is fully depressed) does not allow. Real stroke/end stop unverified; tilt bounds here come from the checklist only.
2D section is the cell-centre plane (most open). The roof drops to 7.61 in above the lip at the side walls (+/-10 in along y); a 3D check should use cell_opening_profile.
Three NECTAR are preloaded against the Back Skin of each upward CELL at match start (Event Field Setup Guide 11.1); not modelled as obstacles.
A-Frame legs are 3D-inclined along y; included as full projections (conservative).
Lip/roof thicknesses are from CAD; plastic part tolerances and skin sag are not published.
